units.source_text: 这封信右近亲自送去，并将源氏大臣之意转达。

en.t: Ukon personally delivered this letter and conveyed Minister Genji's wishes.

units.source_text: 同时送去玉鬘用的衣服以及诸侍女用的物品，不计其数。

en.t: At the same time, countless garments for Tamakazura and articles for her attendant women were sent along.
He had no doubt already explained the matter to Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 送给玉鬘的衣服，是从裁缝所多年积集的服装中选出来的，

en.t: The clothes sent to Tamakazura had been chosen from garments accumulated over many years in the sewing office,

units.source_text: 色彩与式样都极优美，在筑紫的乡下人看来，分外珍奇炫目。

en.t: and their colors and styles were so exquisitely beautiful that to people from the countryside of Tsukushi they seemed especially rare and dazzling.
